title: PaySaathi 1.1.2 — Admin updates and promotional images
notes: Rebuilt the Android customer experience with a clean white theme and refreshed navigation.
Added a welcome/onboarding screen before sign-in and account creation.
Redesigned login, sign-up, OTP, dashboard, service forms, profile and notifications.
Added local demo transaction confirmation with a success animation-style receipt and clearly marked TEST ONLY transaction reference.
Demo receipts are not real payments or operator confirmations; live provider integration is still required.
Removed the blocking Admin loading overlay and restored missing Platform Settings controls.
Added an Admin Updates & Promotions publisher for customer-wide or individual notifications.
Published Admin notifications in the customer dashboard Latest Updates area and notification inbox.
Restored the customer-facing announcement and support contact management flow.
Admin can publish customer-wide or individual updates with optional promotional image uploads.
Promotional images are stored in the public branding bucket and shown in customer dashboard updates and notification inbox.
Restored admin settings, staff and activity sections; removed the blocking admin startup overlay.
